title: Run the portal locally
caption: From a set-up machine (docs/mvp/local-development.md §2) to the portal on :3000.

steps.title: Back-end prerequisites
steps.body: PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7 running, `pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed:reference` done, `.env.local` copied from `.env.example` (it already holds `PLATFORM_API_URL`, `PLATFORM_BFF_KEY`, `PUBLIC_PORTAL_URL`, `PUBLIC_OTA_ADMIN_URL`, `STOREFRONT_BASE_DOMAIN`).
steps.expect: `psql postgres://velexis_platform_app:dev_platform@127.0.0.1:5432/velexis -c 'select count(*) from platform.plans'` answers at least 1 (`early_access`).

steps.title: Mail and Amadeus stand-ins
steps.expect: http://localhost:8025 shows an empty inbox; the stub listens on 4900.

steps.title: Seed the platform once
steps.body: `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-backend dev:seed` (platform admin, test Amadeus account, 40 test offices).
steps.expect: The test Amadeus account is active and offices DEV1A0001… are `available`, so a new OTA gets a test office.

steps.title: Start the API, workers and the portal
steps.body: `pnpm dev` (everything) or, per app: `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-backend dev`, `pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-backend dev` (the OTA worker builds tenant schemas), `pnpm --filter @velexis/platform-frontend dev`.

steps.title: Open the portal
steps.body: Open the landing page, then **Get started**.
steps.expect: The marketing page with one `h1`; no console errors; the CSP header carries a nonce (`'unsafe-eval'` only in development).
